newsitem.title: USA: Lafayette, La., approves $222 million GO bonds.
newsitem.headline: Lafayette, La., approves $222 million GO bonds.

text.p: Voters in Louisiana's Lafayette City-Parish approved three general obligation bond issues totalling $222.1 million in weekend voting, a parish official said Monday.

Approved in Saturday's referendum were $166 million of GOs for street and bridge improvements, $43.6 million of GO bonds for drainage projects and $12.5 million of GO bonds for recreation improvements.
All three passed by wide margins, the parish official said.
Debt service on the 25-year bond issues will be paid with revenues from a one-cent sales tax.
In other referendums Saturday, voters in East Baton Rouge Parish agreed to extend a 3.96-mill property tax for another 10 years to fund park operations.
But voters rejected a proposed new 2-mill property tax to fund expansion of recreation programs administered by the East Baton Rouge Parish Recreation and Park Commission.
